bluegill.text: Sunnies follow worms like kittens follow string. Try the flats by day.

bullhead.text: Mud Kittens come out at dusk in skinny water. Worms, always worms.

crappie.text: Papermouths hide in the lilies at dawn and gossip about minnows.

carp.text: A Golden Bucket will drag your jug clear across the warm flats.

drum.text: Put your ear to the hull over deep mud. That grunting is a Grunter.

channel.text: The Wage pays the rent: liver, cypress shore, after dark.

blue.text: Old Blue sleeps in the deepest hole and wakes for cut shad at night.

flathead.text: The Yellow Cat wants its supper alive. Minnows on the rocks at night.

largemouth.text: Bucketmouth could swallow a sunrise. Minnows in the lilies at dawn.

smallmouth.text: Bronzeback lives on the south rocks and loves a crawfish.

gar.text: Needle-Nose sunbathes in the cypress, then hunts cut bait after sunset.

buffalo.text: The Drifter wanders the deep, bumping into worms by accident.

white_crappie.text: Silver Paper is the creek channel's papermouth. Minnows by the brush.

redear.text: Shellcrackers crunch snails on firm ground. Worms do nicely.

green_sunfish.text: The Green Grump guards the rocks like it owns them.

warmouth.text: Goggle-Eye peeks out of brushy coves at dusk.

redbreast.text: Copper Belly waits at creek mouths with its long ear flap out.

longear.text: Painted Ear is the prettiest fish in the clear shallows. Worms.

spotted_bass.text: Spot hunts where the creek channel drops off. Minnow or craw.

white_bass.text: Sand Bass school where the channel meets open water at dawn.

yellow_bass.text: Stripey hangs over underwater humps. Small minnows by day.

hybrid_striper.text: The Wiper pulls like a motor. Shad over deep humps at dawn.

striped_bass.text: A Rockfish was stocked here once, and it never left. Deep, open water, cut shad.

bowfin.text: Grinnel is older than the lake, they say. Warm weedy backwater, cut bait, night.

spotted_gar.text: Spotted Stick waits beside flooded timber at dusk.

shortnose_gar.text: Stubby Snout noses around muddy creek mouths at dusk.

alligator_gar.text: Gator is the heavyweight. Cut shad in the creek channels. Bring a big well.

black_bullhead.text: Inky is a little cat of quiet mud. Liver after dark.

brown_bullhead.text: Horned Pout hides by the flooded brush on Briar. Liver at night.

blue_sucker.text: The Blue Racer visits the deep gravel on Briar, but only rarely.

bigmouth_buffalo.text: Gourdhead drifts over deep mud and sometimes takes a worm.

black_buffalo.text: The Shadow Drifter keeps to Briar's deep shelf. Worms or cut bait.

golden_shiner.text: Gold Flash darts in the weeds and the Reed Passage. Tiny worm bites.

gizzard_shad.text: Hickory schools roll over open water. Rarely, one bites a worm.

threadfin_shad.text: Thread is so small the hook laughs. Warm open water, if you must.

chain_pickerel.text: Jack is toothy and lives in Briar's lilies. Live minnows.

inland_silverside.text: Glass Sliver is see-through and shy of nothing. Open water, worms.

bluntnose_minnow.text: Button-Nose crowds the creek channels. Worms or dough.

river_carpsucker.text: The Silver Vacuum cleans the creek bottom. Dough balls work.

orangespotted_sunfish.text: Ember-Dot glows in the flooded shoreline. Worms by day.

bigscale_logperch.text: Log-Roller flips pebbles on the dam riprap. Worms.

bullhead_minnow.text: Little Boss rules the channels at dusk. Worms.

lake_trout.text: The Deep Mackinaw follows the cold down and down. Minnows at dawn.

bull_trout.text: Old Bull comes up the inlets at dawn. If you meet one, let it go home.

westslope_cutthroat.text: Red-Throat loves the inlet riffles. Worms by day.

rainbow_trout.text: Sky-Side rises in the inlets and pondweed bay. Dough works too.

brook_trout.text: Speckle is shy and lives in the snowmelt inlet. A quiet boat helps.

brown_trout.text: Butter-Belly lurks by the larch snags at dusk. Minnow or craw.

kokanee.text: Silver Bullets school out deep at dawn. Roe, always roe.

lake_whitefish.text: Snow-Belly grazes the trench bottom. Worms or roe.

mountain_whitefish.text: Pebble-Nose sniffs the inlet stones by day.

pygmy_whitefish.text: Thimble lives so deep it's practically a rumor. Night, worms.

northern_pike.text: The Water Wolf waits in the pondweed with its teeth out.

yellow_perch.text: Tiger-Stripes crowd the pondweed bay and the outpost dock.

burbot.text: The Eelpout comes up at night on the gravel reefs. It's all chin.

largescale_sucker.text: Rubber-Lip vacuums the inlet. Dough balls.

longnose_sucker.text: Snoot keeps to the cold reefs.

peamouth.text: Pea-Pods dimple the bay at dusk.

northern_pikeminnow.text: The Big-Mouth Minnow is no minnow at all. Gravel reefs, dusk.

redside_shiner.text: Sunset Flicker flashes pink over the flats.

slimy_sculpin.text: Puddle-Puss hides under reef stones on cold nights.

mottled_sculpin.text: Patchwork sits so still you'd think it was a pebble.

lake_chub.text: Button pops up anywhere shallow. Dough.

pumpkinseed.text: Penny-Cheek suns itself by the outpost dock.

cisco.text: Lake Herring flash in the open water at dawn.

arctic_grayling.text: Sail-Fin only shows itself to quiet boats in the inlet.

golden_trout.text: Sunbeam lives in the snowmelt shallows. Shy as morning.

tiger_trout.text: Marble-Back prowls the reefs at dusk. Minnows.

splake.text: Twice-Char can't decide what it is, but it likes deep reefs at dawn.

longnose_dace.text: Riffle-Nose noses the inlet stones. Worms.

mountain_sucker.text: Cobble-Kiss kisses every stone in the inlet.

white_sturgeon.text: The Old Plates is older than the outpost. Deep, at night. Let it go.

walleye.text: Glass-Eye sees in the dark. Reefs at dusk, minnows.

sauger.text: Sand-Eye follows the cold into the trench at night.

shorthead_redhorse.text: Rusty Tail flicks red in the inlet. Worms or craw.

fathead_minnow.text: Pudge is everyone's snack. Dough by the dock.

redband_trout.text: Ember-Stripe warms itself by the springs. Worms or grubs.

coastal_cutthroat.text: Rain-Throat hides among the drowned pines at dawn. Quiet boats.

lahontan_cutthroat.text: The Desert King is rare and royal. Deep at dawn. Let it go.

chinook.text: King's Supper roams the cobalt deep at dawn. Roe.

coho.text: Silver-Side flashes in the open caldera at dawn.

tui_chub.text: Button-Belly loafs on the pumice shelf.

speckled_dace.text: Freckle dances in the warm spring shallows.

oregon_chub.text: Moss Pip hides in the moss gardens. Shy, worms.

klamath_smallscale_sucker.text: Soft-Mouth grazes the shelf and the deep. Dough.

blue_chub.text: Bluebell rings near the surface in the moss gardens.

prickly_sculpin.text: Pincushion bristles under the cliffs at night.

umpqua_pikeminnow.text: River Wolf hunts the drowned pines at dusk.

chiselmouth.text: Scraper scrapes the cliff stones by day.

alvord_chub.text: Dust Pip lives only in the warmest springs. Grubs.

cobalt_cisco.text: The Blue Ghost lives where the water is bluest. Deep, dawn.

obsidian_darter.text: Glass Bead darts along the obsidian. Grubs.

ember_char.text: Coal-Belly glows a little at dusk near the springs.

ash_minnow.text: Smudge is grey as ash and everywhere on the shelf.

cinder_sculpin.text: Hot-Rock sits on warm stones at night.

pumice_skipper.text: Bobber-Fish floats like pumice. Dough at the surface.

fumarole_perch.text: Steam-Stripe loves the springs by day.

sulfur_shiner.text: Yellow Spark flickers in the spring water.

basalt_bass.text: Black Brick guards the cliffs at dawn. Crawfish.

glasswing_trout.text: Window-Fin is see-through on clear days in the open.

mistfin_dace.text: Fog-Flicker only comes out when the fog does.

lava_belly_sunfish.text: Hot Penny glows orange in the spring shallows.

geyser_goby.text: Hiccup hops near the springs at night.

moonpool_whitefish.text: Night-Lamp rises in the deep after dark.

snagtooth_pike.text: Old Crook-Jaw waits in the drowned pines at dusk.

fog_mudminnow.text: Hide-Away hides even better in fog.

indigo_eelpout.text: Velvet Rope lives deeper than the light goes. Night, cut shad.

steam_carp.text: Kettle-Lips blows bubbles in the springs. Dough.

rimrock_bullhead.text: Pebble-Whisker pokes around the cliffs at night. Liver.

vent_catfish.text: Warm-Whiskers naps by the deep springs and wakes at night for liver.

comet_minnow.text: Tail-Lights zip up the comet stream. Star-dust.

meteor_bass.text: Rock-Drop crashes into the meteor reefs at rising.

quasar_koi.text: Lantern Koi glow in the lily drifts. Dough or star-dust.

pulsar_perch.text: Blinkers blink in the deep phase. Count the blinks.

lunar_loach.text: Moon-Noodle wiggles through the light-reeds at night.

solar_sunfish.text: Little Sun warms the lily drifts in the bright phase.

starling_shiner.text: Twinkle-Fry flock in the light-reeds at fading.

galaxy_gar.text: Swirl-Snout spirals in the current at fading.

aurora_trout.text: Ribbon-Light shimmers in the comet stream at rising. Roe.

cosmic_carp.text: Big Bubble blows bubbles shaped like planets.

void_eel.text: Long Shadow lives in the void well. Liver, deep phase.

gravity_drum.text: Thumpers thump in the deep. You feel it in the hull.

photon_tetra.text: Sparks light up the reeds at night.

nova_pike.text: Flare-Jaw flares in the crystal kelp at fading.

dwarf_star_darter.text: Speck is tiny, bright and lives on the meteor reefs.

saturnfin_puffer.text: Ring-Ball floats in the current with its fins like rings.

celestial_catfish.text: Star-Whiskers prowls the void well at night. Liver.

moonbeam_crappie.text: Paper-Moon hides in the crystal kelp at rising.

twinkle_shad.text: Glitter-Fry schools in the current. Star-dust.

eclipse_bowfin.text: Half-Moon lurks in the reeds at night.

stardust_bullhead.text: Sprinkle-Cat noses the shoals at night. Liver or worms.

halo_whitefish.text: Ring-Light rises in the open at rising. Roe.

constellation_char.text: Dot-to-Dot follows the current at fading. Connect its spots.

supernova_salmon.text: Burst only bites for the patient, in the current at rising.

event_horizon_goby.text: The Edge-Sitter sits at the very bottom of the void well.

zodiac_zander.text: Twelve-Stripe has a stripe for every month. Reefs at fading.

plasma_pickerel.text: Zap-Jaw zaps in the reeds at rising. Minnows.

ion_icefish.text: Clear-Cat is invisible except at night, deep in the current.

prism_ray.text: Rainbow Kite glides over the shoals on bright days.

comet_tail_betta.text: Silk-Tail flutters at the surface of the lily drifts.

purrsec_lanternfish.text: Purr-Lights purr. You can hear them if you're quiet.

old_lantern.story: As gold as a lamp, and older than the landing. My grandmother said he guards the dock at night.

lily_queen.story: Long as my canoe, and she rises only for misty dawns and a fancy breakfast.

spillway_monster.story: Near a hundred pounds of blue cat in the calm, marked pool. Heavy line, cut shad, after dark.

channel_leviathan.story: Longer than my boat. After rain, deep night, pecan-smoked shad. I'm not making it up.

whiskered_guardian.story: Its whiskers write the twilight on the water. It comes when the lake has been treated kindly.

glacial_phantom.story: A trout so pale it looks like snow mist. Dawn in the inlet.

old_silverhead.story: Older than my boat and my boat's boat. Lives where the cold is.

huckleberrys_whopper.story: It ate my boot and gave it back polished. Snowy night, gravel reefs, roe.

obsidian_gar.story: As black as the cinder shore and twice as shiny.

caldera_fire_lizard.story: Not a fish at all. Something warm walks under the cold.

nebula_weaver.story: It ribbons through the current on aurora nights and leaves light behind.

star_whale.story: A whale made of light. It comes to whoever stops looking for it.
